title: Daily digests
body:
Members can now pick a daily digest in their notification settings (the settings page shipped in #1482). The digest job runs every day; weekly digests still go out on Mondays.

- Each digest covers only the activity since the previous one of its kind, newest first, capped at 25 items with a "and N more" line.
- Members with nothing new get no email.
- Members who chose "off" get nothing.
